title: Services and Dependency Injection
summary: Share logic and data across components with injectable services.
heading: Services and Dependency Injection

blocks.text: A service is a plain class for logic and data that isn't tied to one screen — fetching data, holding shared state, calculations, logging. Components stay focused on the view; services do the rest, and many components can share one.

blocks.caption: Many components share one service.
blocks.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 180' role='img' aria-label='Three components inject one shared service'><defs><marker id='sv-ar' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='6' refY='3' orient='auto'><path d='M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z' fill='currentColor'/></marker></defs><g fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><rect x='18' y='18' width='118' height='40' rx='6'/><rect x='161' y='18' width='118' height='40' rx='6'/><rect x='304' y='18' width='118' height='40' rx='6'/><rect x='140' y='120' width='160' height='46' rx='8'/><line x1='77' y1='58' x2='200' y2='118' marker-end='url(#sv-ar)'/><line x1='220' y1='58' x2='220' y2='118' marker-end='url(#sv-ar)'/><line x1='363' y1='58' x2='240' y2='118' marker-end='url(#sv-ar)'/></g><g fill='currentColor' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'><text x='77' y='42'>Component A</text><text x='220' y='42'>Component B</text><text x='363' y='42'>Component C</text><text x='220' y='147'>UserService</text></g><g fill='currentColor' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle' opacity='0.7' font-family='monospace'><text x='150' y='95'>inject()</text></g></svg>

blocks.text: Without services, logic ends up copy-pasted into components, and data gets passed through layers of inputs and outputs just to reach where it's needed. Services solve that.

layers.title: Reuse
layers.detail: Write logic once, use it in any component — no duplication

layers.title: Thin components
layers.detail: Components handle the view; services handle data and rules

layers.title: Single source of truth
layers.detail: One place owns the data, so screens stay in sync

layers.title: Easy to test & swap
layers.detail: Test a service on its own; replace it without touching components

blocks.text: Let the CLI create it. A service is just a class marked @Injectable.

blocks.label: Terminal
blocks.code:
ng generate service user
# short version:
ng g s user

blocks.label: user.service.ts

blocks.text: providedIn: 'root' makes one shared instance available everywhere — a singleton for the whole app.
You don't create a service with new. You ask for it and Angular hands you the shared instance — that's dependency injection. Use the inject() function.

blocks.label: user-list.ts

blocks.caption: You ask the injector; it provides the singleton.
blocks.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 120' role='img' aria-label='Component asks the injector which provides the service'><defs><marker id='di-ar' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='6' refY='3' orient='auto'><path d='M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z' fill='currentColor'/></marker></defs><g fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><rect x='12' y='40' width='120' height='44' rx='8'/><rect x='160' y='40' width='120' height='44' rx='8'/><rect x='308' y='40' width='120' height='44' rx='8'/><line x1='132' y1='62' x2='158' y2='62' marker-end='url(#di-ar)'/><line x1='280' y1='62' x2='306' y2='62' marker-end='url(#di-ar)'/></g><g fill='currentColor' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'><text x='72' y='66'>Component</text><text x='220' y='66'>Injector</text><text x='368' y='66'>Service</text></g><g fill='currentColor' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle' opacity='0.7' font-family='monospace'><text x='145' y='34'>inject()</text><text x='293' y='34'>provides</text></g></svg>

blocks.text: You can also inject through the constructor: constructor(private users: UserService) {}. Both do the same thing; inject() is the modern style.

Where you provide a service decides how many instances exist. providedIn: 'root' creates one singleton shared by the whole app. Listing a service in a component's providers array instead creates a fresh, scoped instance for each copy of that component (and its children).

blocks.caption: Singleton: one shared instance. Scoped: one per component.
blocks.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 440 180' role='img' aria-label='Singleton shares one service; scoped gives each component its own'><defs><marker id='sc-ar' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='6' refY='3' orient='auto'><path d='M0,0 L6,3 L0,6 Z' fill='currentColor'/></marker></defs><g fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><rect x='18' y='14' width='78' height='28' rx='5'/><rect x='112' y='14' width='78' height='28' rx='5'/><rect x='62' y='112' width='84' height='32' rx='7'/><line x1='57' y1='42' x2='95' y2='110' marker-end='url(#sc-ar)'/><line x1='151' y1='42' x2='112' y2='110' marker-end='url(#sc-ar)'/><rect x='250' y='14' width='78' height='28' rx='5'/><rect x='344' y='14' width='78' height='28' rx='5'/><rect x='250' y='112' width='78' height='32' rx='7'/><rect x='344' y='112' width='78' height='32' rx='7'/><line x1='289' y1='42' x2='289' y2='110' marker-end='url(#sc-ar)'/><line x1='383' y1='42' x2='383' y2='110' marker-end='url(#sc-ar)'/></g><g fill='currentColor' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'><text x='57' y='32'>Comp</text><text x='151' y='32'>Comp</text><text x='104' y='132'>Service</text><text x='289' y='32'>Comp</text><text x='383' y='32'>Comp</text><text x='289' y='132'>Service</text><text x='383' y='132'>Service</text></g><g fill='currentColor' font-size='10' text-anchor='middle' opacity='0.7' font-family='sans-serif'><text x='104' y='168'>Singleton (root)</text><text x='336' y='168'>Scoped (providers)</text></g></svg>

blocks.label: singleton — shared app-wide
scoped — one per component

layers.title: Use a singleton
layers.detail: Global, shared data: auth, cart, app config, caches

layers.title: Use a scoped service
layers.detail: Per-component state that shouldn't leak: a wizard/form's state, a local store

blocks.text: A scoped service is created with its component and destroyed with it — handy for state that should reset each time the component appears.

items: A service is a class for reusable logic/data, marked @Injectable.
